blind.B1: Yes, analyze. The wheel experiment (gastrocnemius, 16 samples: CTRL vs DA at ZT4 and ZT16, n=4 each) is voluntary wheel training, an exercise study, but both arms exercise: the paper compares only daytime vs night-time wheel-active mice and states that sedentary-vs-wheel is not part of its study (S2.3.p1 'we only compared daytime and night-time wheel active animals'). The treadmill samples (24 quadriceps, Sed/Ex+0h/Ex+3h at ZT0/ZT12, plus Sed ZT4/ZT16) belong to a separate experiment (S2.2, S3.3). Exercise factor in this case: DA (daytime wheel + dark-phase food restriction) vs CTRL (ad libitum, night-time wheel).
blind.B2: S3.8.p1 / Fig 12A: DA vs CTRL at ZT4 (2094 DEGs) and at ZT16 (368 DEGs); n=4 mice per group per ZT in the RNA-seq (16 samples, GEO titles CTRL/DA ZT4/ZT16 1-4). Behaviour/physiology panels use n=24 (Fig 8) and qPCR n=4 (Fig 9-11).
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one muscle per mouse, mice single-housed (S2.3.p1), sacrificed at different ZTs; ZT4 and ZT16 groups are different animals. Candidate pairing keys in packet A (ZT + title suffix) are arbitrary within-group replicate numbers; the expression check says not_supported (r -0.024 vs 0.007, p 0.70).
blind.B4: The paper does not say whether one DESeq2 model was fitted on all samples or per comparison. S2.8.p2 only says 'DESeq2 version 1.26.0 was used for statistical analysis of gene level differential expression' with shrinkage log2 fold changes.
blind.B5: S3.3.p2: 'differentially expressed genes (DEGs; FDR <= 0.05)'; no fold-change cutoff is stated for RNA-seq. Counts: 2094 DEGs at ZT4 and 368 at ZT16 for DA vs CTRL (S3.8.p1); the FDR rule is stated in the treadmill section and not restated for the wheel experiment.

checks.evidence: S2.3.p1, S3.8.p1: CTRL vs DA is the paper's own wheel comparison; both arms exercise and the estimand is training timing, recorded in study caveats and in the discrepancy list (no sedentary arm).

act CTRL 8 / DA 8, zt Z04 8 / Z16 8, cells n=4 each (packet B, covariance design_check); matches GEO titles and S3.8/Fig 9-11 n=4. The 24 treadmill samples are excluded with a named reason (analysed in the treadmill case).

paper_reconstruction.planned_contrasts says 'DA vs CTRL at ZT4/ZT16' (S3.8.p1: effect of daytime training), but design.contrasts sets control='DA at ZT4', treatment='CTRL at ZT4' (and same for ZT16), i.e. the executed log2FC is CTRL/DA, the reverse of the planned contrast. Mechanical flag possible_reversed_contrast agrees. Example in paper_gene_check: Nr4a3 log2FC -3.88, Klf15 -0.87, Klf4 -1.04 (higher in DA, reported as negative). DEG counts and sets are unaffected; only the sign and up/down split (1121 up/1136 down at ZT4) are flipped relative to the paper's DA-vs-CTRL reading.
checks.fix: In design.contrasts set control = 'CTRL at ZT4' / 'CTRL at ZT16' and treatment = 'DA at ZT4' / 'DA at ZT16' (rename act_DA_vs_CTRL_zt-Z04 / -Z16), re-run execute with run_joint_deseq2 and regenerate up/down counts and the paper_gene_check; update the exploratory act_zt contrast so DA is also the treatment side.

checks.evidence: S2.3.p1 single-housed mice, one muscle each; repeated_measure_unit 'none'. pairing_check not_supported (same-key r -0.024, permutation p 0.70); the candidate key is only the replicate number.

Paper silent (S2.8.p2). Case fits one cell-means model on all 16 samples. ZT16 count 369 vs 368 is nearly identical, but ZT4 gives 2257 vs 2094 (+7.8%), so a pairwise fit may differ somewhat. Only the joint fit is reported.
checks.fix: Optional sensitivity: fit each ZT pair alone (8 samples) and report its ZT4 count next to the joint fit; the paper-silent joint-vs-pairwise question is an open policy item.

checks.evidence: All male, same strain, single-housed, same sequencing run, lanes summed; ZT fully crossed with act (4 per cell). Feeding schedule and wheel timing differ between arms by design and are recorded in study caveats.

Matrix is tximport lengthScaledTPM pseudo-counts (integer_fraction 0.273), rounded to integers (rounding_documented true) and run through DESeq2 as in S2.8.p2. p-value histogram is healthy (frac p>0.9 = 0.109 / 0.121; frac p<0.05 = 0.212 / 0.099).

padj <= 0.05 inclusive, no FC cutoff, transcribed from S3.3.p2 (treadmill section) and applied to the wheel experiment; no other rule in the table fits the paper's counts better (padj<0.05 & |lfc|>0.585 gives 537/60; p<0.05 gives 4151/1944). The threshold_source locator S3.3.p2 is not the wheel section, so the extension to the wheel data is an assumption.
checks.fix: Optionally note in the threshold reasoning that the wheel section S3.8 does not restate the rule and FDR <= 0.05 is carried over from S3.3.p2.

checks.evidence: Same contrast and same rule: ours 2257 vs paper 2094 (ZT4), 369 vs 368 (ZT16). Route is declared_deviation with the deviations listed. Note Klf5 is padj 0.10 at ZT4 in our result though the paper lists it among the overlap genes; this is a small gene-level mismatch, not a count claim.
No stop or refusal; the case ran to completion. The only absence claim (no sedentary arm in the wheel experiment) is true per S2.3.p1.

human_items: Open policy: joint cell-means fit versus per-ZT pairwise fit when the paper is silent; ZT4 count 2257 vs paper 2094 may partly reflect the joint dispersion estimate.
Open policy: carrying the FDR <= 0.05 rule from the treadmill section (S3.3.p2) to the wheel experiment.
summary: 该案例的分组、n、矩阵与方法、阈值(FDR<=0.05)和与论文的计数对比都成立(2257 vs 2094,369 vs 368),小鼠单笼饲养且无重复测量,配对检查不支持任何候选键。唯一需要修改的是对比方向:论文与规划写的是 DA vs CTRL,但实际执行以 DA 为参照、CTRL 为处理,log2FC 符号与上调/下调数相反(DEG 集合和数量不变)。建议把对比改为 DA 为处理、CTRL 为对照并重跑。
